name: seed
label: seed (0 = random)
hint: sampling seed; with several samples, seeds seed .. seed+N-1 (0 = a random seed per sample)

name: n_samples
label: samples per Generate
hint: independent samples (one run each, queued for the duplex worker)

name: clip_s
label: generated seconds (after the prefill)
hint: how long the model generates after the opening prefill (capped by A's length: the conversations are 120 s)

name: dup_mode
label: generate

choice_labels.duo: both sides (two model states, each hears the other)
choice_labels.replay: B only, A = the real recording (replay)

hint: both sides: B (the avatar) and A are each generated by their own model state (own KV cache), each hearing the other's generated voice, 243 ms line delay after the opening (user rule: conversations generate both sides). Replay: only B is generated, A is the conversation's real other side (or silence); Call 1086 is replay only

name: prefill_line
label: opening: partner audio

choice_labels.aligned: aligned during the opening (as in training)

hint: both-sides mode only. Aligned: during the opening prefill each state hears the other's real opening aligned (as in training); the 243 ms line delay starts with the partner's first generated frame. Delayed: the line delay applies from t = 0 (the poseduplex samples pages' gen_pd.py)

name: conv
label: conversation

choice_labels.call1086: Call 1086 mic as A (118 s; B = the avatar's voice + actor prefill)

hint: held-out Aloe conversation: B = the chosen side (its own voice clip in the system prompt), A = the other side's real audio, heard frame by frame. 'Call 1086' = the user's live call mic as A, B = the avatar's voice clip + actor prefill

name: side
label: B = side
hint: which speaker of the conversation the model plays (B); A = the other speaker (ignored for Call 1086)

name: prefill_s
label: opening prefill seconds
hint: first S s of the conversation: B's streams forced to the real recording (lane frames <= N+1, codes / pose frames < N, N = 2 x round(S / 0.16) + 2); generation continues after. 0 = no prefill

name: prefill_pose
label: prefill: pose
hint: force B's pose to the real pose tokens of the opening

name: prefill_audio
label: prefill: audio
hint: force B's speech codes to the real Mimi codes of the opening

name: prefill_words
label: prefill: words
hint: force B's word lane to the real timed words of the opening (off with audio on: PAD lane, off-distribution)

name: a_after
label: A after the opening
hint: what channel A hears after the prefill seconds: the recording's other side, or nothing

name: person
label: avatar
hint: the avatar the generated pose drives (no real-video prefill)

name: voice_clip
label: voice clip prompt
hint: 10-27 user: off (default) = NO voice clip in either side's system prompt (the empty block, as a training row whose clip draw was false); on = each side's own clip, as before

name: factorised_text
label: factorised text sampling
hint: Factorised text sampling (default on): each frame B first decides PAD / NEW_WORD / WORD (EOB too when allowed) from the model's probabilities (category temperature, PAD bias), then, only if WORD, which word piece, renormalised over word pieces. Every other text knob below (temperature, top-k, top-p, min-p, frequency / repetition penalties, adaptive text rep-pen) applies to that word choice only, so PAD / NEW_WORD timing is never penalised, truncated or temperature-shifted. Off = the old joint sampling (the knobs act on the whole lane distribution; min-p default 0), for comparison.

name: cat_temp
label: category temperature
hint: Category temperature: temperature of the PAD / NEW_WORD / WORD decision (factorised sampling only; no penalties or truncation there). 1 = the model's own probabilities.

name: pad_bias
label: PAD bias
hint: Added to B's PAD logit before sampling: negative = B stays silent less and speaks more (-1 makes PAD e = 2.7x less likely relative to the other choices; 0 = off, the model's own timing; positive = more silence). Factorised sampling: the PAD / NEW_WORD / WORD decision (in nats when the category temperature is 1); joint sampling: the PAD token logit. Ignored while the adaptive PAD bias is on.

name: adaptive_pad_on
label: adaptive PAD bias on
hint: Adaptive PAD bias: when on, the PAD bias depends on how long B has been silent and replaces the static PAD bias: 'PAD bias while silent' once B has not spoken (no word or NEW_WORD in its lane) for the silence threshold, 'PAD bias otherwise' the rest of the time. The timer starts at the first conversation frame, so it never kicks in before the threshold. Off = the static PAD bias above.

name: pad_silent_s
label: adaptive PAD: silence threshold (s)
hint: Silence threshold (seconds, 80 ms frames): B counts as silent once its last spoken lane token (word piece or NEW_WORD; PAD / EOB never count) is at least this long ago (adaptive PAD bias only).

name: pad_bias_silent
label: adaptive PAD: bias while silent
hint: PAD bias while B has been silent for the threshold or longer (adaptive PAD bias only): negative = B starts speaking sooner (-1 makes PAD e = 2.7x less likely; same units as the PAD bias).

name: pad_bias_other
label: adaptive PAD: bias otherwise
hint: PAD bias the rest of the time, i.e. while B spoke within the threshold (adaptive PAD bias only): 0 = the model's own timing; positive = more pauses.

name: text_temp
label: text temperature
hint: text temperature of the word choice. Words only: with factorised sampling it acts on the word choice alone (after B decided to say a word); PAD / NEW_WORD timing never touched.

name: text_topk
label: text top-k
hint: keep the k most likely word pieces (0 = off). Words only: with factorised sampling it acts on the word choice alone (after B decided to say a word); PAD / NEW_WORD timing never touched.

name: text_topp
label: text top-p
hint: nucleus over word pieces: smallest set reaching this mass (1 = off). Words only: with factorised sampling it acts on the word choice alone (after B decided to say a word); PAD / NEW_WORD timing never touched.

name: min_p
label: word min-p
hint: min-p on the word choice (0 = off; default 0.05 with factorised sampling, 0 with joint). Words only: with factorised sampling it acts on the word choice alone (after B decided to say a word); PAD / NEW_WORD timing never touched.

name: min_p_rel
label: min-p relative
hint: min-p mode: 0 absolute (p_w >= p, top word kept), 1 relative (p_w >= p x top word); p_w = probability among word pieces

name: freq_pen
label: frequency penalty
hint: frequency penalty: word-piece logit -= strength x count among B's last N word pieces. Words only: with factorised sampling it acts on the word choice alone (after B decided to say a word); PAD / NEW_WORD timing never touched.

name: freq_win
label: frequency window
hint: frequency penalty window: B's last N word pieces

name: text_rep
label: text repetition penalty
hint: CTRL repetition penalty on word pieces present in the window (1 = off). Words only: with factorised sampling it acts on the word choice alone (after B decided to say a word); PAD / NEW_WORD timing never touched.

name: text_rep_win
label: text rep window
hint: text repetition penalty window: B's last N word pieces

name: cb0_temp
label: speech cb0 temperature
hint: audio codebook 0 (semantic, 4B speech tower) temperature

name: cb0_topk
label: speech cb0 top-k
hint: audio codebook 0 top-k (0 = off)

name: light_temp
label: speech cb1-31 temperature
hint: codebooks 1-31 (0.6B decoder) temperature

name: light_topk
label: speech cb1-31 top-k
hint: codebooks 1-31 top-k (0 = off)

name: audio_rep_pen
label: speech repetition penalty
hint: CTRL repetition penalty per codebook on codes used in the window (1 = off)

name: audio_rep_win
label: speech rep window
hint: audio repetition window (conversation frames)

name: word_greedy
label: greedy word choice
hint: when B says a word, take the most likely word piece (after the word penalties; timing / category still sampled)

name: cfg_cb0
label: audio CFG on cb0
hint: with CFG on: also apply it to B's cb0 audio logits (uncond + s (cond - uncond), before the audio rep-pen)

name: adaptive_rep_on
label: adaptive rep-pen on
hint: on: each frame uses the SPEAKING or SILENT penalties below instead of the static audio / text repetition penalties

name: speak_window_frames
label: speaking window (frames)
hint: SPEAKING = B emitted a word piece (not PAD / NEW_WORD / EOB) in its last N frames (80 ms each; 25 = 2 s)

name: audio_rep_speaking
label: speech rep-pen while speaking
hint: audio repetition penalty (cb0 + cb1-31, audio repetition window) while B is SPEAKING (1 = off)

name: audio_rep_silent
label: speech rep-pen while silent
hint: audio repetition penalty (cb0 + cb1-31, audio repetition window) while B is SILENT (1 = off)

name: text_rep_speaking
label: text rep-pen while speaking
hint: text repetition penalty (text repetition window) while B is SPEAKING (1 = off); words only with factorised sampling

name: text_rep_silent
label: text rep-pen while silent
hint: text repetition penalty (text repetition window) while B is SILENT (1 = off); words only with factorised sampling

name: pose_rep_cb0_speaking
label: pose cb0 rep-pen while speaking
hint: pose cb0 repetition penalty (pose repetition window) while B is SPEAKING (1 = off); replaces pose_rep when adaptive is on

name: pose_rep_cb0_silent
label: pose cb0 rep-pen while silent
hint: pose cb0 repetition penalty while B is SILENT (1 = off); replaces pose_rep when adaptive is on

name: pose_rep_light_speaking
label: pose light rep-pen while speaking
hint: pose cb1-31 repetition penalty while B is SPEAKING (1 = off); replaces pose_rep_light when adaptive is on

name: pose_rep_light_silent
label: pose light rep-pen while silent
hint: pose cb1-31 repetition penalty while B is SILENT (1 = off); replaces pose_rep_light when adaptive is on

name: pose_temp
label: pose cb0 temperature
hint: pose codebook 0 (4B pose tower) temperature (standing rule: 1)

name: pose_topk
label: pose cb0 top-k
hint: pose codebook 0 top-k (0 = off; standing rule: 30)

name: pose_light_temp
label: pose cb1-31 temperature
hint: pose codebooks 1-31 (0.6B pose decoder) temperature (standing rule: 1)

name: pose_light_topk
label: pose cb1-31 top-k
hint: pose codebooks 1-31 top-k (0 = off; default 151 = the user's own setting; 30 freezes the pose)

name: pose_cfg_on
label: pose CFG on
hint: Pose CFG (default off): guides the pose with an uncond stream = the same input with every Mimi code (B's and A's, voice clip included) replaced by digital-silence codes and the mic (Voxtral) input replaced by digital zero (the FastPPM / SAM CFG-3 recipe). Switchable mid-session: the uncond stream always runs.

name: pose_cfg_s
label: pose CFG strength
hint: pose CFG strength w: l = l_uncond + w (l_cond - l_uncond); 1 = cond exactly (released recipe: 3)

name: pose_cfg_cb0
label: pose CFG on cb0
hint: with pose CFG on: guide pose codebook 0

name: pose_cfg_light
label: pose CFG on cb1-31
hint: with pose CFG on: guide pose codebooks 1-31

name: pose_cfg_speaking_only
label: pose CFG only while speaking
hint: with pose CFG on: guide only while B is SPEAKING (a word piece in its last speak_window_frames frames, the adaptive rep-pen's rule); silent frames use the plain cond logits (the uncond rows still run every frame)

name: pose_cfg_keep_mic
label: pose CFG keeps your mic
hint: with pose CFG on: the uncond stream keeps YOUR live mic (the same Voxtral input as the cond stream) and silences only B's Mimi codes, so CFG amplifies the pose's response to B's own audio only (monoplex-like). Off (default) = the FastPPM / SAM recipe: the mic is replaced by digital zero too. Switchable mid-session.

name: pose_rep
label: pose repetition penalty (cb0)
hint: pose repetition penalty on codebook 0 (1 = off): CTRL penalty on the cb0 codes used in the last pose_rep_win frames, before temperature / top-k (after the pose CFG mix) = fast_ppm's POSE REP; keeps the body from freezing in one pose

name: pose_rep_light
label: pose repetition penalty (cb1-31)
hint: pose repetition penalty on codebooks 1-31, per codebook (1 = off)

name: pose_rep_win
label: pose rep window
hint: pose repetition window in pose frames (80 ms each; 64 = 5.1 s)
